title: Set followed by a program
statement: Let a limit record, program, execution depth, list of integer values $l$, local-memory function $\mu$, budget $T$, postcondition $Q$, index $x$, expression $e$, statement $s$, and integer $z$ be given. If $s$ can execute from the state whose local values are obtained by setting position $x$ of the frame of $l$ to $z$, using cost at most $T-(\mathrm{cost}(e)+1)$, and its final state satisfies $Q$, and if $e$ is safe in the state with local values given by the frame of $l$ and memory $\mu$ and evaluates there to $z$, with $\mathrm{cost}(e)+1\le T$, then the sequence that first assigns $e$ to position $x$ and then executes $s$ can execute from that initial state with cost at most $T$ and final state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The continuation s has an execution from the state with local values set at x to z and memory μ, of cost at most T − (cost(e)+1), ending in a state satisfying Q.
Expression e is safe in the initial state with locals frame(l) and memory μ, and evaluates there to z.
